mabi: mab'i — not; a form of mawi 'not' (mab'i chi kowin chik 'he could no longer')
couin: kowin — be able, have strength; kow 'strong' + -in
xcul: xkul — it was smeared on (inferred); x- completive + kul 'smear, coat', the verb of xki kul 'they coated'
